name: Dr. Malavathu Ram Naik
notes:
NO LEGITIMATE PUBLIC SOURCE FOUND - ALL FIELDS DELIBERATELY LEFT BLANK. Four query variations were run and none produced a usable, permitted source: (1) exact name plus 'anaesthesia' restricted to aighospitals.com; (2) 'Ram Naik' plus 'anaesthesia liver transplant' restricted to aighospitals.com; (3) 'Dr. Ram Naik' OR 'Dr. M Ram Naik' plus AIG plus anaesthesia, restricted to aighospitals.com; (4) surname 'Naik' plus 'liver transplant anaesthesia team' restricted to aighospitals.com. A fifth, unrestricted open-web query on the full name plus 'doctor Hyderabad' was also run, and a sixth combining 'Ram Naik' + Malavathu + anaesthesiologist + liver transplant + AIG Gachibowli.

AIG HAS NO INDEXED PER-DOCTOR PAGE FOR HIM. He appears in none of AIG's four URL families - not /doctor/<slug>, not /doctors/<slug>, not /doctor-profile/<slug>, not /doctor-profile/<numeric-id> - and not on the speciality-filtered doctor listings that did surface (https://aighospitals.com/doctors?speciality=28 for anaesthesia and https://aighospitals.com/doctors?speciality=31 ). This is a genuine absence from the index, not the trailing-slash artifact: no plural URL bearing his name was returned in ANY form, with or without a trailing slash, so there was no slashed URL to retry without the slash. Because nothing surfaced verbatim, no URL could be recorded - constructing one from AIG's known slug pattern would breach the no-construction rule, and that rule binds however confident the pattern feels. No translate.goog mirror surfaced for him either. Notably, four of his five assigned AIG liver-transplant-anaesthesia colleagues on this batch (rows 1496, 1499, 1515) DID return canonical /doctor/ pages on the very same queries, so the search method is demonstrably working - he specifically is not published.

THE ONLY HITS ON HIS NAME WERE BARRED SOURCES, AND WERE DISCARDED, NOT USED. The single result that matched the exact name was a ZoomInfo contact-broker record (https://www.zoominfo.com/p/Ram-Malavathu/6687846732) titled 'Contact Ram Malavathu, Email: ****@aighospitals.com & Phone Number | Junior Consultant at AIG Hospitals'. This is barred twice over under golden rule 4: ZoomInfo is a named contact-broker/scraped database that the validator rejects outright, AND the address it shows is MASKED ('****@aighospitals.com'), which must never be completed. No email and no phone was taken from it. The biographical detail that a WebSearch summary attached to this row - a Consultant post at Star Hospitals, a Fellowship in Liver Transplant Anaesthesia at the Asian Institute of Gastroenterology, a prior Emergency Medical Officer post at Stanley Medical College, and an MD from Madras Medical College - traces back to that same broker/scraped-profile layer and to no indexed page I could attribute to him, so it is recorded here as UNVERIFIED CONTEXT ONLY and has been kept out of every structured field, including specialization, city and verified_role. It is written down solely so a human does not have to repeat the search.

WHY NOT 'Ambiguous Match': that status is reserved for two same-name people who genuinely cannot be told apart. That is not the situation here - the problem is total absence of any permitted source, not a collision. Note for the human reviewer: no OTHER doctor of this name surfaced anywhere, so there is no confusion risk; the distinctive Banjara/Lambadi surname 'Malavathu' is rare and unambiguous, which makes the silence informative. If the ZoomInfo fragment is right that he holds or held a JUNIOR CONSULTANT grade, that would explain the absence directly: AIG does not publish profile pages for junior grades, and it is also consistent with the possibility that he has since moved on from AIG to Star Hospitals. Both readings are speculation and neither was recorded as fact.

STATUS IS 'Needs Human Review' AND BAND IS 'Unknown', as section 5 requires when nothing can be confidently verified. NO ownership, leadership, HNI signal or experience figure could be assessed at all, so hni_signals is blank rather than guessed and owns_clinic is left at its default false meaning 'not established', not 'confirmed to own nothing'. SUGGESTED NEXT STEP FOR A HUMAN WITH PAGE ACCESS: check the Star Hospitals Hyderabad doctor directory for a vascular or transplant anaesthesia consultant of this name, and check the Telangana State Medical Council register - a council registration number would settle identity and neither route is reachable with WebSearch alone. The pipeline's automatic AIG hospital-level fallback remains the only contact route on this row, and it should be treated as unconfirmed for this individual because his current affiliation is itself unverified.
